outputs.explanation: Body weight, LW/BW, and FW/BW are shown as scatter/dot plots with individual mouse data points (black dots for NC, red squares for HFD) overlaid on the mean ± SD bars.
This is a gross photograph of mouse abdominal cavity, not a plot showing averaged data.
This panel consists of representative micrograph images (H&E and Oil Red O staining), not a plot of averaged data.
This is a dot blot (5mC) and methylene blue staining image, not a plot showing averages.
The 5mC/Methylene Blue quantification is a bar chart showing mean ± SD with individual data points (dots for NC and HFD, n=5 each) overlaid.
The bottom panel bar chart of TET1/TET2/TET3 over GAPDH ratios displays mean ± SEM with individual data points (circles for NC, squares for HFD) overlaid for each group.
